name: VIPER-RSR
source:
A game that blends old school dungeon crawling along with animated cutscenes.

It is a dark age in the kingdom of Alitalia. Monsters ransack cities, slaughtering the men and taking the women as their slaves. Four adventurers set out to end the rampages...

[More from [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/products/games/rsr.html]sognadigitalmuseum[/url]]
translation:
一款融合了经典地牢探索和动画过场的游戏。

阿利塔利亚王国正处于黑暗时代。怪物洗劫城市，屠杀男性并将女性掳为奴隶。四位冒险者踏上了终结暴行的征程……

[更多信息来自[url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/products/games/rsr.html]sognadigitalmuseum[/url]]
